11-INCH LIQUID RETINA DISPLAY — The gorgeous Liquid Retina display is an amazing way to watch movies or draw your next masterpiece.* True Tone adjusts the display to the color temperature of the room to make viewing comfortable in any light.

IPADOS + APPS — iPadOS makes iPad more productive, intuitive, and versatile. With iPadOS, run multiple apps at once, use Apple Pencil to write in any text field with Scribble, and edit and share photos.* iPad comes with essential apps like Safari, Messages, and Keynote, with over a million more apps designed specifically for iPad available on the App Store.

UNLOCK AND PAY WITH TOUCH ID — Touch ID is built into the top button, so you can use your fingerprint to unlock your iPad, sign in to apps, and make payments securely with Apple Pay.

ADVANCED CAMERAS — iPad features a 12MP Center Stage front camera that’s perfect for video calls and selfies. The 12MP Wide back camera with True Tone flash is perfect for document scanning and capturing photos and 4K videos.

keywords.text: Customers are satisfied with the iPad's performance, describing it as excellent and exactly what they wanted.

partialReviews.text: ...This one was a great price and love it! Everything transferred from my old iPad easily. The battery lasts much longer than my old one....

keywords.name: Functionality
keywords.text: Customers find the tablet's functionality positive, reporting that it works well and has no issues, with one customer noting it handles schoolwork effectively.

partialReviews.text: Works great, bought as a replacement for an older model #8... this is a good value and so far, excellent battery life...

keywords.name: Value for money
keywords.text: Customers find the tablet well worth the price and would buy it again.

partialReviews.text: ...This one was a great price and love it! Everything transferred from my old iPad easily. The battery lasts much longer than my old one....
...Good screen quality and scratche resistant. Good price compared to $350 from Apple.
Great purchase! Always stick with the Apple brand for consistent quality. It is a great size for a very non-technical husband....
...I have always liked iPads, so easy to use and setup, this was a great buy on prime day.This new one is so fast.

keywords.name: Battery life
keywords.text: Customers are satisfied with the tablet's battery life, noting that it charges quickly and can last up to two days with light to moderate use.

partialReviews.text: ...Perfect for watching movies and videos. And the occasional game. Great battery life and great quality considering it’s Apple. I got the silver one.
...The screen is clear, battery life is great, and it’s perfect for studying, working, editing, or just relaxing....
...Don't recommend this 2025 A16 chipset model due to poor battery life.
...Pretty pink. Exactly what I needed for light work and scrolling. Battery life is good. It will last all day with heavy usage. Charges quickly....

keywords.name: Enjoyment
keywords.text: Customers find the iPad enjoyable, with multiple customers mentioning that their children love using it.

partialReviews.text: This is my first iPad and I love it. Really great for watching movies or videos in bed. My eyesight is failing and the TV is too far away sometimes....
Works well. Set this up for my mother who has diminished eyesight she loves it and it helps her to see photos and play games on a larger screen.
I use this for online mathematics teaching and I absolutely love it. Battery life is extremely great and the sound quality is good....
Great gift, this is easily transported and the charge lasts a great amount of time when away from home.

keywords.name: Setup
keywords.text: Customers find the tablet easy to set up and use, with apps launching instantly.

partialReviews.text: ...It was easy to set up and appears to work just as nicely as my older I-pad Pro. It worked well on a recent Euro vacay....
Great size, good quality, easy to setup, this was a gift for hubby. As he ages, he needs a larger screen and this delivers....
...It is very easy to use and has a long battery life, I can go days without charging it.
The initial setup process hangs when it asks to set up Apple Pay. Powering down and up doesn't resolve the issue....

keywords.name: Color
keywords.text: Customers love the color of the iPad, particularly its pink shade, with one customer noting its vivid dark print.

partialReviews.text: Love the color but the device got stuck at the same place during setup and I was never able to actually use the device....
...It’s super fast, the display is crisp and vibrant, and the battery life easily lasts all day....
...Decided to try this iPad and the screen, battery life, color, and ease of use matches the mini....
...It's a nice compact size, I love the color, I got the watermelon. Easy to set-up, a nice display and charges quickly....
